summary: The bill amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to make noncitizens who assault law enforcement or military personnel or vandalize public property during civil unrest deportable, permanently inadmissible, ineligible for any relief, subject to mandatory detention, and eligible for expedited removal during declared emergencies.

scores.thoughts: The bill contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budget authority. It focuses exclusively on immigration enforcement mechanisms.
No tax-related provisions appear in the bill text.
The bill does not address healthcare policy, coverage, or regulation.
No references to firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.

The bill directly amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to expand grounds for deportation and permanent inadmissibility for aliens (including DACA recipients and LPRs) involved in assaults on law enforcement or military during civil unrest, bars all forms of relief, mandates detention, and authorizes expedited removal. This is a clear and strong expansion of immigration enforcement and restriction measures.
No provisions related to reproductive rights or abortion access.
The bill references assaults on members of the Armed Forces as a deportable offense but does not address military spending, budgets, or defense policy.
No environmental or climate provisions.
The bill does not modify any welfare, benefits, or social safety net programs.
No education-related content.
No references to drugs, decriminalization, or enforcement.

The bill strengthens immigration consequences (mandatory detention, expedited removal, permanent bars) for certain riot-related criminal acts against law enforcement, which has a tangential effect of increasing enforcement severity, but it does not alter criminal sentencing, policing, or the justice system itself.
No trade, tariffs, or globalization provisions.
No fiscal or debt-related measures.
No provisions affecting LGBTQ+ legal protections.
No foreign aid provisions.
No election or voting provisions.
No technology, data, or privacy provisions.
No labor, union, or employment provisions.
No religious liberty or anti-discrimination provisions.
